$comment: Runway rendering of Avoid: items. Runway only follows positive instructions, so every avoid item becomes a positive phrase, or null when the item is about audio/dialogue (Runway renders no sound, so it is dropped). Keys are matched case-insensitively against the exact avoid item. tools/render-prompt.mjs refuses to render a Runway prompt with an unmapped item; add it here.

map.subtitles: a clean picture free of captions
map.readable text inside the bubbles: chat bubbles filled with soft, abstract grey lines
map.readable text or numbers on the screen: the monitor shows soft, abstract shapes and bars
map.map labels: a city seen as pure light and shape
map.street names: a city seen as pure light and shape
map.black bars, pillarbox or letterbox borde: the picture fills the full frame edge to edge
map.camera movement or zoom: the camera stays locked off at a fixed focal length
map.phones, screens or any object appearing: the right side of the frame stays a plain, empty wall
map.objects in the right side of the frame: the right side of the frame stays a plain, empty wall
map.phones: an uncluttered frame with hands free of devices
map.screens: an uncluttered frame with hands free of devices
map.props: an uncluttered frame with hands free of devices
map.extra people in focus: at most two people in focus
map.hands reaching for the phone: the phone rests untouched on the desk
